Options:
  --fix  Apply available fixes
  --unsafe-fixes  Include unsafe fixes
  --diff  Display proposed changes
  --select RULES  Select rule codes
  --ignore RULES  Ignore rule codes
  --output-format FORMAT  Select report format
  --target-version VERSION  Select Python target version
  --exclude PATTERNS  Exclude paths
  --no-cache  Disable caching
  --exit-zero  Return success despite findings
  --config CONFIG  Set configuration path or a setting
  --isolated  Ignore configuration files
  -q, --quiet  Reduce output
  -v, --verbose  Increase output detail
